assumptions.name: Randomised treatment
assumptions.text: 'treatment' was assigned at random, so no covariate affects assignment (no covariate->treatment edges). Verify with balance checks.

assumptions.name: Overlap / positivity
assumptions.text: Every covariate profile has a non-zero chance of being treated and untreated. Checked empirically by propensity-score overlap diagnostics.

assumptions.name: Consistency / SUTVA
assumptions.text: A unit's observed outcome equals its potential outcome under the treatment received, and one customer's treatment does not affect another's outcome (no interference).

assumptions.name: Pretreatment covariates only
assumptions.text: Covariates are measured before treatment. Post-treatment variables (e.g. exposure, revenue) are excluded because adjusting for them can introduce bias.

assumptions.name: Correlation vs causation
assumptions.text: The DAG is an assumed structure. Association in data does not prove these arrows.

assumptions.name: Possible unobserved confounder (U_unmeasured)
assumptions.text: Drawn as a dashed node to remind readers that unmeasured causes of both treatment and outcome would bias estimates; refutation tests cannot rule this out.
